name: Dajna
body:
Dajna
CR 8

This titanic camel is covered in long, coarse russet hair. Its head reaches to the treetops and beyond and its tread is like thunder.

XP 4,800
N Gargantuan magical beast
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 6, flat-footed 20 (+14 natural, –4 size)
hp 105 (10d10+50)
Fort +12, Ref +7, Will +9
Resist electricity 20, sonic 20

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee bite +15 (2d8+9/19–20 plus grab), hooves +13 (2d6+4 plus trip), tail slap +13 (1d8+4)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks fling, spit thunder, stomp, trample (2d6+13, DC 24)

STATISTICS

Str 29, Dex 10, Con 20, Int 2, Wis 19, Cha 9
Base Atk +10; CMB +23 (+25 bull rush, +27 grapple); CMD 33 (35 vs. bull rush, 37 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (bite), Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack
Skills Perception +17
SQ mother’s milk, temper temper

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Fling (Ex)

When a dajna has grappled a creature with its bite, as a move action it can hurl the creature up to 10 feet in the air and 20 feet away, causing the creature to take 3d6 bludgeoning damage and fall prone when it lands. If another creature is in the square where the creature lands, that creature also takes 3d6 points of bludgeoning damage (DC 24 Reflex half). The save DC is Strength-based.

Mother’s Milk (Su)

A female thunder camel can produce heavenly tasting yellowish milk. A creature that drinks the milk within 24 hours of its production gains the benefits of the heal spell, which also cures mundane problems like baldness and other superficial physical imperfections. It can produce one dose of mother’s milk each day.

Stomp (Ex)

As a standard action, a dajna stomps on a prone creature within its reach. The target takes 6d6+12 points of bludgeoning damage (DC 24 Reflex half). The dajna can also use its attack of opportunity to stomp an opponent standing from prone. The save DC is Strength-based.

Temper Temper (Su)

For one minute after a dajna takes damage, it gains the benefits of the haste spell. Once within that duration when it would fail a Will save, as an immediate action it can choose to reroll that saving throw, taking the result of this second save even if it is worse. If the dajna is affected by calm emotions or similar magic, it loses its benefits from haste for the duration of calming effect.

Thunderous Spit (Su)

Once every 1d6 rounds as a standard action, a dajna utters a deafening cough that is audible within 1 mile, dealing 4d6 points of sonic damage (DC 20 Fortitude half) to all creatures within 20 feet. It then expectorates a spitball of tremendous size and spews it in a 60-foot line. Each creature in the area takes 4d6 points of electricity damage and 4d6 points of bludgeoning damage (DC 20 Reflex half). The creature in the area farthest from the dajna is entangled in viscous fluid, taking 1d6 points of nonlethal damage and 1d6 points of electricity damage each round at the start of its turn. It gains a new Reflex save each round at the end of its turn to end the effect, and also can escape the spitball with a DC 20 Strength check. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ABOUT

A dajna is a camel of titanic proportions. It is not generally aggressive, but its sheer size is a danger to anything smaller than itself. Also called a thunder camel, a dajna has the head and neck of a camel but is ten times the size of an elephant. They were once more numerous, but in the wake of a primordial deluge or similar cataclysm it was left behind where other beasts found rescue and went extinct in most lands as a result, but a population of these colossal camels survived in the netherworld.

Although a dajna is highly dangerous to human beings, the yellowish milk produced by the females is a remedy for baldness and many other afflictions. Only heroes dare retrieve it.
